end.summary:
Named ants, earthworms, and beetles as animals found in soil.
Discussed beetles living in soil as well as flying.
Corrected the idea that earthworms are insects: insects have six legs; earthworms do not.
Earthworm harm misconception remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming small soil animals and sorting earthworms from insects by the number of legs. The six-legs rule helped correct the insect mix-up later in the lesson, but the idea that earthworms harm crops was still present at the end. At home, look at a picture of an earthworm and talk about how its tunnels let air and water into soil and how it helps make rich soil from dead leaves.
